Hostile validation verdict, gate admin-pwa-source-round6, wordpairs source revision 3fb4a49a28ce5281ab91fa88c4d488458762ea27 (staging readiness only). Local timestamp 2026-10-29T10:42:32. OverallVerdict DISAGREE. Accuracy 97. Completeness 95. Both are below 98. PASS 39, FAIL 2, UNKNOWN 3 of 44.

What holds: every gate run (full run cb73504d and PowerShell runs, [PRIVATE HOST]) follows commit 3fb4a49; all 14 JUnit/TRX hashes, 4 run-level pairs, 4 producer hashes and the manifest hash match; unit 588, PostgreSQL 68, browser 78, planner 6/6 mock and real, script contracts 3 and docs drift 6 pass with 0 failed and 0 skipped, 1:1 by name. The 284-path manifest equals the committed tree. No src change since 1c22727; the browser lane ran all eight invitation cases, the whitespace case and the reaction case. All 27 repository PowerShell files are analyzer-clean in my independent run. Round5 dispositions: F-R5-1 remediated (failure analysis accurate, cause stated unproven, error-context loss stated; two minor unreceipted statements, I-R6-1); F-R5-2 remediated for producers, exact commands, module binding, negative controls and contract JUnit/TRX, with a residual run-id linkage gap (F-R6-1); F-R5-3 remediated in the four documents, but the new drift check is weak (F-R6-2). Round5 UNKNOWNs: S2-07 resolved by the operator's direct-instruction statement; remote wiki S1-21 resolved by git ls-remote (430298bb); effort and failsafe 5ca5 remain UNKNOWN. QBrain INVITE-COPY-01/02/03 and TR-23-C02 are live, unsatisfied, natively mapped (71 edges) and present in the committed canonical export. The round2 receipts are recovered and their five hashes match an uncommitted index change outside 3fb4a49, exactly as qualified. Nothing is claimed done or deployed. No credential appears in any tracked file or public copy.

Why DISAGREE:
F-R6-1 (low): the evidence index's run id 01d8f57f and exit codes for planner, contract and docs runs come from an aggregator (evidence.json) that no committed script produces, and they do not link to the committed producers' own run ids (def6a841, b531c42c); the validation.json orchestrator is also uncommitted.
F-R6-2 (low): the documentation drift check forbids five exact legacy sentences, so reworded drift passes, and it omits deployment_plan.md and README.md; proposed AC-DOCS-01 and tests are in the finding.
UNKNOWN: reviewer runtime effort (this run and round5); prior failsafe 5ca5 fate; BDPv4 mock-first order for the new documentation check (no receipt either way).
I-R6-1 to I-R6-8 are informational.

Not claimed and still pending: migration 012 on staging then production, live GitHub consent, standalone phone OAuth continuity, physical installation, hosted invitation behavior, hosted rollout, production and power-loss durability. The invitation and planner original chronologies remain historically non-compliant and are not changed by catch-up receipts; the original reaction failure cause remains unproven.
